protocol.distance_anchor: median pooled all-cell nearest-neighbor distance; original cell multiplicities
protocol.graph: Euclidean radius graph components from Euclidean MST on Delaunay edges; exact duplicate points grouped with multiplicity
protocol.empty_region: bounded complement components of raster union of disks; not anatomical labels
protocol.support_comparison: convex hull area; all-cell fraction outside glial convex hull; all-to-glial distances; disk-union area
protocol.representatives: six sections: force both S12; greedy farthest-first Euclidean coverage of minmax-scaled log(N),log(maxspan),log(NNmedian),log(aspect),log(max MST edge/d0),hole area fraction at disk4d0; registry-order ties

limitations: Coordinates/identities authenticated by semantic hashes, not whole HDF5 hash reread
Raster holes are geometric scale diagnostics, not anatomical authentication
No FEM operators or candidate production meshes generated
component_sizes_encoding: exact size:multiplicity histogram plus largest 20; no sizes omitted from histogram

proposed_study_representatives.rationale: Supplement coverage with geometry extremes before any candidate covariance evaluation; proposed not frozen
